attributes.title: database_query
attributes.description: Execute one deployment-approved bounded Named Query alias. Arbitrary SQL, arbitrary Named Query paths, transactions, QueryString parameters, and dynamic datasource selection are not exposed.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Validated Value-style parameters declared by the approved alias.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Dataset page size. 0 selects the registry default. Hard ceiling 2000. Ignored only for scalar aliases.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Dataset offset for aliases whose approved pagination mode is offset. Default 0.
